The following topics are some of Franziska’s most popular keynote topics.

THE COURAGE MAP

Taking the Road Less Travelled

A keynote based on her bestselling book The Courage Map (foreword by Sir Richard Branson).

As leaders, we’re often called to take the road less travelled in order to lead with confidence, stay innovative, and face uncertainty with courage.

In this captivating presentation, Franziska shares experiences gleaned from her motorcycle journey around the world, seamlessly weaving together profound insights on courage rooted in the realms of neuroscience and psychology.

Commencing her expedition from the picturesque landscapes of Switzerland, she embarked on an awe-inspiring journey spanning over 12,000 kilometres, tracing the historic Silk Road until reaching the expanse of Kazakhstan, with a stop at the Iranian border, where she was denied entry due to an unexpected mishap.

In this keynote, you’ll embark on an enlightening journey of discovery, delving into a multifaceted array of themes:

  • Courage Unveiled: A profound exploration into the essence of courage as a cultivated skill, capable of not only fortifying your own resolve but also serving as a contagious beacon of inspiration to those in your orbit.

  • Perspectives Unearthed: A revelatory exploration into the art of uncovering fresh, unexpected perspectives from the most seemingly ordinary sources, enriching your capacity for insight and innovation.

  • The Zen of Resilience: Insights into cultivating resilience and unlocking the wisdom of maintaining a tranquil state of mind, even in the face of adversities.

  • Travel Tunes: An introspective examination of the vital “mantras” — the guiding principles and attitudes — that shall fortify your courage as you embark upon the road less travelled.

  • Pit Stops: A contemplative exercise exploring the most incisive and enlightening questions to pause and reflect upon.

 

Prepare yourself for an enthralling odyssey filled with captivating narratives that inspire and motivate. You’ll walk away energized, equipped with the essential tools to lead with unwavering courage, and with a newly awakened sense of adventure.

 

PERCEPTION

How Perception Shapes Reality
(and How to Take Control of Yours)

Based on Franziska’s bestselling book Perception, this keynote unpacks one of the most powerful forces shaping our world — how we see and how we are seen.

  • Why do engagement rings almost always feature diamonds?

  • Why has the socks-and-sandals look made a comeback?

  • Why did Dolly Parton lose a look-alike contest — of herself?

  • Why do some ideas spread like wildfire while others fizzle out?

The answer? Perception.

Perception doesn’t just shape reality — it creates it. And it works both ways: the way you see the world and the way others see you directly influence your success, relationships, and opportunities. But instead of leaving it to chance, what if you could take charge of perception and use it to accelerate success?

In this session, you’ll discover:

  • How to take control of how people perceive you in both business and life.

  • How to reshape your own perception to create a more fulfilling reality.

  • How to attract the right people and opportunities with intentional influence.

  • How to be in the driver’s seat of your results by mastering the power of perception.

 

Franziska shares practical tools and strategies you can apply to both your business and personal life, including eye-opening case studies and examples from throughout history.

    UNshakable

    Embracing Change, Choice, and Courage
    in a Fast-Paced World

    In today’s fast-paced and unpredictable world, the only constant is change. But amid uncertainty, you have a choice: to let circumstances shape you or to rise above them. The power to thrive lies in your ability to adapt, choose boldly, and lead with courage.

    This keynote will guide you on a journey to becoming truly unshakable by mastering three powerful forces — Change, Choice, and Courage.

    Through engaging stories, actionable insights, and proven tools grounded in neuroscience and psychology, you’ll explore how to:

    • Embrace Change: Transform the fast pace of life and business into opportunities for growth and innovation.

    • Empower Your Choices: Align your decisions with your values, even when faced with tough options.

    • Build Courage: Develop courage as a skill to take bold action, conquer fear, and become unshakable.

    Prepare yourself for an enthralling odyssey filled with captivating narratives that inspire and motivate. You’ll walk away empowered, energized, and equipped with the tools to navigate change with confidence, make choices that feel good, and embrace courage in the face of life’s challenges.

    You’ll have your very own roadmap to becoming unf*withable** — ready to thrive, no matter what comes your way.

      UNspoken

      Ignite Curiosity, Invite Courage, Inspire Connection

      with Franziska Iseli & Nic Thomas

      What happens when you swap small talk for real connection?
      Join us for a lively, transformative keynote that explores the power of meaningful conversations and how they shape culture, leadership, and performance in business.

      In this session, Franziska and Nic will unpack three core elements:

      Curiosity
      Breakthroughs rarely happen on autopilot. They show up when you step out of routine and let curiosity and wonder lead the way. Learn how better questions unlock better thinking, creativity, and problem-solving.

      Courage
      Courage is not only for cliff jumps and big life decisions. It’s a practical skill every human needs to be future ready. Discover how courageous conversations help you navigate uncertainty, address the unspoken, and make braver choices.

      Connection
      Real impact happens at the level of relationship. Explore how to move from surface-level chatter to deeper, more meaningful conversations that strengthen trust, collaboration, and loyalty. Less small talk, more soul talk.

      This keynote is a playful path into deeper connection.

      Franziska and Nic are also the founders of unspoken.one, conversation cards that ignite curiosity, invite courage, and inspire connection.

       

      THE MARKETING ECO-SYSTEMTM

      A Smarter Way to Grow Your Business with Clarity
      and Confidence

      So many business owners have a scattered approach to marketing, which means that they are not getting a great return from their efforts. The Marketing EcosystemTM framework changes all that. It’s the essential blueprint every business needs to ensure that all marketing efforts — online and offline — work seamlessly together, creating a system that fuels growth, generates better returns, and brings consistency to your strategy.

      Key Takeouts From This Workshop:

        • Maximizing Returns Across All Marketing Channels: Learn how to make every marketing effort count by aligning online and offline strategies for maximum impact.

        • The Four Marketing Funnels Every Business Needs: Understand the crucial funnels that every business must build to attract, nurture, and convert leads consistently.

        • Choosing the Right Marketing Strategies with Confidence: Say goodbye to feeling overwhelmed. We’ll help you choose the strategies that align with your unique business goals and target audience.

        • Building a High-Impact Marketing Machine and Leveraging AI: Get hands-on insights into creating a marketing system that adapts with the latest trends and innovations, ensuring you stay ahead of the curve.

        • The Core Metrics for Growth: Discover the key metrics to track for a clear picture of your performance, helping you adjust and grow strategically.

      Thousands of entrepreneurs and business owners have transformed their marketing approach with the Marketing Ecosystem™. You’ll walk away with your personalized ecosystem mapped out and ready to implement, so you can start driving growth with clarity, consistency, and renewed focus.

       

      THE BRAND ALCHEMY METHODTM

      Transform Your Brand from Invisible to Irresistible

      What makes a brand unforgettable? How do you create a business that becomes the most coveted name in its space — and sustain it?

      In a world where consumers are more discerning than ever, building a powerful brand is no longer a choice; it’s a necessity. With the fast-evolving media landscape and shifting consumer behaviors, businesses need to be more than just visible — they need to be irresistible. Today’s consumers crave brands with a deep sense of purpose, authentic connections, and engaging communication that goes beyond transactions.

      Branding isn’t just about being noticed; it’s about being chosen. While marketing may attract potential customers, branding is what makes them choose you. The strength of your brand determines whether your business thrives or fades into the background.

      In this session, you’ll discover…

      • The Brand Alchemy Method™ – A practical methodology to create a compelling, courageous, and impactful brand strategy.

      • The ten essential elements of becoming the “go-to brand” in any industry.

      • How to leverage AI to craft compelling content aligned with your brand strategy.

      • How to win the minds and hearts of strangers and turn them into raving fans.

      • The art of storytelling and how to leverage a bold narrative to captivate your audience.

      • How to communicate with clarity and confidence, crafting messages that resonate with the right audiences.

      • Practical examples from Franziska’s own successful, “tattoo-able” brands.

      Join renowned entrepreneur and brand strategist Franziska Iseli as she reveals her proven strategies for building brands that people don’t just recognize — they want to be a part of.

       

      With real-world examples from her own ventures — two of which have become so iconic that fans have them tattooed — Franziska will show you how to elevate your brand through the art of bold branding.
